full_list.title_en: Explicit pore pre-conditioning and inverse design of amorphous nanoporous carbon
full_list.title_zh: 非晶纳米多孔碳的显式孔隙预处理与反设计
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Porous carbons store energy, capture gases and purify water, and their performance depends strongly on the geometry of their pores. Atomistic models mostly simulate their synthesis by molecular dynamics, with results that depend on the interatomic potential, and return the pore network as an output rather than as a specification. Here we show that the pore network can be an input: pores drawn from a target size distribution fill a prescribed volume fraction, carbon is grown around them by stochastic ring placement, and a particle swarm recovers the construction parameters from a structural fingerprint. The search reproduces the density, surface area and pore volume of a carbon produced by quenched molecular dynamics within about 5 %, together with its pore size distribution. As a stress test, it also recovers a bimodal distribution, and the search history reveals which parameters the targets constrain and flags a failed search. A short anneal completes the network, recovering the coordination of the reference while the pore size distribution keeps its shape. Molecular dynamics still supplies the local chemistry, but the pore geometry becomes a design variable for a given application.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多孔碳可以储存能量、捕获气体和净化水，其性能在很大程度上取决于其孔隙的几何形状。原子模型主要通过分子动力学模拟它们的合成，其结果取决于原子间势，并将孔隙网络作为输出而不是作为规范返回。在这里，我们表明孔隙网络可以作为输入：从目标尺寸分布中提取的孔隙填充规定的体积分数，通过随机环放置在它们周围生长碳，并且粒子群从结构指纹中恢复构造参数。该搜索重现了由淬火分子动力学产生的碳的密度、表面积和孔体积（误差在 5% 左右）及其孔径分布。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 多孔碳可以储存能量、捕获气体和净化水，其性能在很大程度上取决于其孔隙的几何形状。原子模型主要通过分子动力学模拟它们的合成，其结果取决于原子间势，并将孔隙网络作为输出而不是作为规范返回。在这里，我们表明孔隙网络可以作为输入：从目标尺寸分布中提取的孔隙填充规定的体积分数，通过随机环放置在它们周围生长碳，并且粒子群从结构指纹中恢复构造参数。该搜索重现了由淬火分子动力学产生的碳的密度、表面积和孔体积（误差在 5% 左右）及其孔径分布。作为压力测试，它还恢复双峰分布，搜索历史记录显示目标限制哪些参数并标记失败的搜索。短暂的退火完成了网络，恢复了参考的配位，同时孔径分布保持其形状。分子动力学仍然提供局部化学，但孔隙几何形状成为给定应用的设计变量。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《非晶纳米多孔碳的显式孔隙预处理与反设计》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Closed-form dyadic Green functions for transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Closed-form dyadic Green functions for transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A transversely uniaxial bianisotropic medium with equal magnetoelectric scalars was conceived by Weiglhofer in 1994. Using the scalar factorization method, he concluded that the dyadic Green functions of this medium could not be found in closed form. That conclusion is incorrect. The essentials of the derivation are reproduced here, and closed-form expressions are given for all four dyadic Green functions of the unbounded medium, linking the electric and magnetic fields to electric and magnetic source current densities.

full_list.title_en: Open-shell Configuration State Functions as trial states for phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Open-shell Configuration State Functions as trial states for phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The accurate description of open-shell states in molecular systems poses challenges for approximate electronic structure methods. One emerging approach is to variationally optimize the orbitals of a single user-selected Configuration State Function (CSF), i.e., a linear combination of Slater determinants that is constructed as an eigenstate of the total spin operator. In this work we explore the use of these orbital-optimized single CSFs as trial wavefunctions in phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (ph-AFQMC), a stochastic method that recovers electron correlation by evolving an initial state in imaginary time, subject to a constraint imposed by the trial state. We investigate the symmetric stretch of H-He-H, a series of small p-block compounds with diradicaloid singlet states, twisted ethene conformers, and a bimetallic iron-sulfur complex. We find that accurate energetics are obtained for states dominated by open-shell character, and that for certain atoms and diatomics the accuracy can be significantly improved when the trial is made to also preserve the relevant angular momentum symmetries. Furthermore, our study reveals that the open-shell CSF trial is suboptimal when the target electronic state reflects a significant mixture of ionic and covalent character, e.g., at shorter bond lengths in H-He-H and for the superexchange-stabilized ground state of [2Fe-2S]²⁺. Our findings suggest that ph-AFQMC using CSF trial states is a promising method for many (but not all) strongly correlated molecular states, especially given its relatively low computational cost, and that it provides a reasonable non-perturbative way to recover some of the dynamic correlation that is otherwise missing in the CSF.

full_list.title_en: Sympathetic Cooling of Ionic Fullerenes with Ultracold Atoms to Millikelvin Temperatures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Sympathetic Cooling of Ionic Fullerenes with Ultracold Atoms to Millikelvin Temperatures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cooling complex molecular ions to millikelvin temperatures remains a major challenge because their intricate internal structures prevent laser cooling. Here, we propose to use an ultracold gas of Cd atoms to efficiently cool C₆₀⁺ ions to average kinetic energies of approximately 20 mK, following an initial precooling stage with He buffer gas. Our approach is based on full molecular dynamics simulations using accurate ion-atom interaction potentials derived from high-level electronic structure methods. Furthermore, using a Monte Carlo approach, we predict the formation of C₆₀⁺ Coulomb crystals supported solely by collisions with the buffer gas. The probability of reaching these cold states shows a pronounced dependence on the number of trapped ions, revealing the competition between neutral-atom cooling and many-ion dynamics in radio-frequency traps.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Bidirectional teleportation using scrambling dynamics: a practical protocol
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.15536v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We show that quantum information scrambling can enable a generic SWAP gate between collective degrees of freedom in systems without universal local control. Our protocol combines a Hayden-Preskill type recovery scheme, associated with the black hole information paradox, with quantum teleportation and runs them in parallel and in opposite directions, enabling bidirectional exchange of quantum states through global interactions alone. This approach cleanly distinguishes the roles of information spreading, entanglement, and chaos for enabling both coherent state transfer and recovery. We propose an experimental realization using the Dicke model, which can be realized in optical cavity and trapped-ion platforms, highlighting the utility of holography in designing practical quantum gates.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Classification and Signatures of Dissipative Quantum Hall-Superconductor Junctions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional quantum Hall (FQH) edges with proximity-induced superconductivity can host parafermionic zero modes (PZMs), making them a promising platform for topological quantum computing. Recent experiments [Gül et al., Phys. Rev. X 12, 021057 (2022)] measured the edge conductance from crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) between counter-propagating FQH edges separated by a narrow superconductor. The observed conductance was small and non-quantized, with two distinct behaviors: some states show temperature-independent conductance, while others show conductance that grows as temperature decreases. We explain these results by dissipation to sub-gap modes in the superconductor and present a phase diagram for the FQH-superconductor junction. We show that for Jain states, temperature-independent non-quantized conductance occurs only in the presence of an integer mode (such as at filling ν=1±frac1m, with odd m≥3) strongly coupled to the dissipative channel. The predicted temperature trends qualitatively agree with the experiment, which shows temperature-independent conductance for ν=2/3 and integer states, but not for ν=1/3 and ν=2/5. We propose comparing ν=4/3 and 2/3 to test the predicted influence of the relative chirality of integer and fractional modes.

full_list.title_en: Colloquium: A critique on van der Waals and two-dimensional magnets
full_list.title_zh: 座谈会：对范德华和二维磁体的批判
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.19417v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic two-dimensional (2D) crystals were isolated about a decade ago, triggering a tremendous research activity worldwide. This colloquium raises a stiff question: what is really new about them? At first sight, they seem to be purer implementations of 2D spin models than traditional systems such as ultra-thin films. Yet, they partly realized their promises so far, and whether they give fresh perspectives on long-standing predictions in statistical physics is still an open question. Undoubtedly, they are uniquely amenable to electric-field effect, susceptible to mechanical deformation, and sensitive to moirés, for example. They represent interesting platforms for exploring, challenging, or simply revisiting a wide range of phenomena in condensed matter magnetism. This colloquium intends to offer a critical, yet not necessarily skeptical, overview of the field, clarifying what we believe could be unique with 2D magnets, related quasi-2D van der Waals magnets, and their heterostructures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 大约十年前，磁性二维 (2D) 晶体被分离出来，引发了全球范围内的巨大研究活动。这次研讨会提出了一个棘手的问题：它们到底有什么新鲜之处？乍一看，它们似乎是比超薄膜等传统系统更纯粹的 2D 自旋模型实现。然而，到目前为止，他们部分实现了他们的承诺，他们是否对统计物理学的长期预测提供了新的视角仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。毫无疑问，它们特别容易受到电场效应的影响，容易受到机械变形的影响，并且对莫尔条纹敏感。它们代表了探索、挑战或简单地重新审视凝聚态磁性中的各种现象的有趣平台。

full_list.title_en: Cost scaling of MPS and TTNS simulations for 2D and 3D systems with area-law entanglement
full_list.title_zh: 使用面积法则纠缠的2D和3D系统的MPS和TTNS模拟的成本缩放
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.08132v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Tensor network states are an indispensable tool for the simulation of strongly correlated quantum many-body systems. In recent years, tree tensor network states (TTNS) have been successfully used for two-dimensional systems and to benchmark quantum simulation approaches for condensed matter, nuclear, and particle physics. In comparison to the more traditional approach based on matrix product states (MPS), the graph distance of physical degrees of freedom can be drastically reduced in TTNS. Surprisingly, it turns out that, for large systems in D>1 spatial dimensions, MPS simulations of low-energy states are nevertheless more efficient than TTNS simulations. With a focus on D=2 and 3, the scaling of computational costs for different boundary conditions is determined under the assumption that the system obeys an entanglement (log-)area law, implying that bond dimensions scale exponentially in the interface area of the associated subsystems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 张量网络状态是模拟强相关量子多体系统不可或缺的工具。近年来，树张量网络状态（ TTNS ）已成功用于二维系统，并为凝聚态、核和粒子物理学的量子模拟方法提供基准。与更传统的基于矩阵乘积状态（ MPS ）的方法相比， TTNS中的物理自由度图距离可以大大降低。令人惊讶的是，对于D > 1空间维的大型系统，低能态的MPS模拟仍然比TTNS模拟更有效。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《使用面积法则纠缠的2D和3D系统的MPS和TTNS模拟的成本缩放》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Dynamical Signatures of Selective Gap Closing in Multi-Dimensional Monotone Quasiperiodic Operators
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dynamical Signatures of Selective Gap Closing in Multi-Dimensional Monotone Quasiperiodic Operators
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05686v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We translate the spectral gap-closing criterion for multi-dimensional monotone quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators into a concrete dynamical protocol and verify it by large-scale numerics. For a non-principal label we construct a sampling function whose leading eigenfunction weight at the origin vanishes; a local bump then drives the residual weight through zero. The height of a weighted oscillatory time average of the origin-to-localization-center correlator exhibits a deep minimum precisely at the closing, while the site-control label remains featureless and orders of magnitude larger. The signature is robust and maps directly onto superconducting-circuit and photonic platforms.

full_list.title_en: Exact Mirror-Parity Selection Rule for Electron-Phonon Coupling in Two-Dimensional Crystals
full_list.title_zh: 二维晶体中电子声子耦合的精确镜宇称选择规则
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electron--phonon (e-ph) interaction underlies conventional superconductivity and plays a central role in transport and other many-body phenomena in solids. Here, we derive a symmetry selection rule for e-ph scattering in two-dimensional crystals possessing a horizontal mirror plane, σₕ. For electronic states of mirror parity sₙ(k) and sₘ(k+q), and a phonon mode of parity χ_ν(q), we show that the e-ph matrix element gₘₙ,ν(k,q) vanishes identically unless sₙ(k),χ_ν(q), sₘ(k+q)=+1. The rule follows from the covariance of the phonon-induced deformation potential under σₕ, constitutes the Cₛ case of the general group-theoretical selection rule for matrix elements, and partitions the e-ph interaction throughout the Brillouin zone into symmetry-allowed and symmetry-forbidden scattering channels. Consequently, mirror-even phonons couple electronic states of the same mirror parity, either even--even or odd--odd, whereas mirror-odd phonons couple only states of opposite mirror parity, for both intra- and interband processes. We illustrate the selection rule through first-principles calculations for the two-dimensional superconductor Sc₂BCH₄, where mirror parity is well defined throughout the entire Brillouin zone and symmetry-forbidden matrix elements vanish up to numerical precision. We then extend the analysis to bulk MgB₂, where the rule applies exactly only on mirror-invariant planes of the three-dimensional Brillouin zone. Moving away from these planes removes the exact mirror constraint and activates scattering channels that are symmetry forbidden when the mirror eigenvalues are well defined. Our results establish horizontal mirror symmetry as an exact and practical filter of e-ph scattering processes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子-声子 (e-ph) 相互作用是传统超导性的基础，在固体输运和其他多体现象中发挥着核心作用。在这里，我们推导了具有水平镜面 σₕ 的二维晶体中 e-ph 散射的对称性选择规则。对于镜像宇称 sₙ(k) 和 sₘ(k+q) 的电子态以及宇称 χ_ν(q) 的声子模，我们证明 e-ph 矩阵元素 gₘₙ,ν(k,q) 相同消失，除非 sₙ(k),χ_ν(q), sₘ(k+q)=+1。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电子-声子 (e-ph) 相互作用是传统超导性的基础，在固体输运和其他多体现象中发挥着核心作用。在这里，我们推导了具有水平镜面 σₕ 的二维晶体中 e-ph 散射的对称性选择规则。对于镜像宇称 sₙ(k) 和 sₘ(k+q) 的电子态以及宇称 χ_ν(q) 的声子模，我们证明 e-ph 矩阵元素 gₘₙ,ν(k,q) 相同消失，除非 sₙ(k),χ_ν(q), sₘ(k+q)=+1。该规则遵循 σₕ 下声子引起的变形势的协方差，构成了矩阵元素的一般群论选择规则的 Cₛ 情况，并将整个布里渊区的 e-ph 相互作用划分为对称允许和对称禁止的散射通道。因此，对于带内和带间过程，镜像偶声子耦合相同镜像奇偶校验的电子态，偶-偶或奇-奇，而镜像奇声子仅耦合相反镜像奇偶校验的状态。我们通过二维超导体 Sc2BCH4 的第一原理计算来说明选择规则，其中镜像宇称在整个布里渊区中得到了很好的定义，并且对称禁止矩阵元素在达到数值精度时消失。然后，我们将分析扩展到块体 MgB2，其中该规则仅适用于三维布里渊区的镜面不变平面。远离这些平面会消除精确的反射镜约束，并激活当反射镜特征值明确定义时对称性禁止的散射通道。我们的结果将水平镜像对称性确立为 e-ph 散射过程的精确且实用的滤波器。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化, 电子—声子耦合与输运，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Field evolution of the multi-k magnetic states in NdB₄ revealed by neutron diffraction
full_list.title_zh: 中子衍射揭示 NdB₄ 多 k 磁态的场演化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06526v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the magnetic states of the Shastry-Sutherland-lattice magnet NdB₄ using single-crystal neutron diffraction. We focus on magnetic fields applied along the tetragonal c axis, which stabilise the fractional 1/5~magnetisation plateau. In the low-temperature phase below 4.9 K, the transition into the plateau state at approximately 12 kOe is marked by a change in the propagation vectors from (1/5,0,-2/5) and its double (2/5,0,1/5) to (0,0,1/5) and (0,0,2/5). At the transition from the plateau to a nominally `field-polarised' state near 33 kOe, all magnetic reflections associated with non-integer propagation vectors disappear, whereas reflections corresponding to the k=0 component persist throughout the entire field range. We conclude that that the in-plane components survive even in the high-field phase and that the polarisation is, in fact, incomplete. The observed field dependence provides direct support for a description of NdB₄ in terms of two coupled magnetic instabilities: all-in-all-out order of the in-plane moments and a spin-density wave of the out-of-plane components.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用单晶中子衍射研究了 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格磁体 NdB₄ 的磁态。我们关注沿四方 c 轴施加的磁场，它稳定了分数 1/5~磁化平台。在低于 4.9 K 的低温相中，在大约 12 kOe 处向平台状态的转变以传播矢量从 (1/5,0,-2/5) 及其双倍 (2/5,0,1/5) 到 (0,0,1/5) 和 (0,0,2/5) 的变化为标志。

full_list.title_en: First-principles study of the formation of Group-IV--vacancy color centers in diamond
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：First-principles study of the formation of Group-IV--vacancy color centers in diamond
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: XV (X is Si, Ge, Sn, or Pb, and V is the carbon vacancy) color centers are promising platforms for quantum computing and quantum information science due to their favorable optical and spin properties. They are commonly fabricated by ion implantation, which inevitably introduces vacancies and carbon self-interstitials (Cᵢ) into the lattice. However, the microscopic formation mechanism remains unclear, limiting the yield and stability of XV centers. Here, first-principles calculations are conducted to systematically investigate the roles of V and Cᵢ in XV formation. We find that XV formation is energetically favorable, with large binding energies and low diffusion barriers. Nevertheless, XV readily captures Cᵢ to form substitutional defect Xₛ, or captures an additional V to form the complex XV₂. Charge transition levels show that oppositely charged reactants never meet in these reactions, and that Coulomb repulsion blocks them only when both reactants carry charges of the same sign, which for the capture of Cᵢ requires strongly n- or p-type conditions. These competing defect reactions destabilize the split-vacancy configuration and could account for the low formation yield of XV centers, so that they appear at concentrations well below those expected from the implanted dose. Our results elucidate the microscopic origin of this intrinsic instability and suggest that Fermi-level control may suppress defect conversions and stabilize the split-vacancy configuration.

full_list.title_en: Helicons in multi-Weyl semimetals
full_list.title_zh: 多外尔半金属中的螺旋
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2504.15426v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Helicons are low-frequency, circularly polarized transverse electromagnetic modes that propagate in three-dimensional conducting systems in the presence of a static magnetic field. Here, we investigate helicon excitations in gapless multi-Weyl semimetals (mWSMs) with topological charge (J=1,2,) and (3) using semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory. We incorporate both Berry-curvature and orbital-magnetic-moment corrections into the quasiparticle dynamics and determine the optical-conductivity tensor in the presence of a weak static magnetic field. The longitudinal conductivity is obtained analytically for single-, double and triple-Weyl systems, whereas the transverse conductivity is evaluated numerically in the low-frequency regime relevant to helicon propagation. We find that the cyclotron frequency acquires a nontrivial dependence on the topological charge and on the magnetic field. The resulting helicon dispersion retains the characteristic quadratic dependence on the wave vector, while the axion-electrodynamics contribution generates an additional linear term. We further show that the axion term lifts the degeneracy of the gapped collective modes at zero wave vector, with the resulting mode frequencies determined by the (J)-dependent plasma frequencies. These results demonstrate that the helicon response provides a probe of the distinct electrodynamic properties of multi-Weyl semimetals.
full_list.abstract_zh: 螺旋是低频圆极化横向电磁模式，在存在静磁场的情况下在三维传导系统中传播。在这里，我们使用半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论研究了具有拓扑电荷 (J=1,2,) 和 (3) 的无间隙多外尔半金属 (mWSM) 中的螺旋激发。我们将贝里曲率和轨道磁矩校正合并到准粒子动力学中，并确定弱静磁场存在下的光导张量。单外尔系统、双外尔系统和三外尔系统的纵向电导率是通过分析获得的，而横向电导率是在与螺旋传播相关的低频区域中通过数值计算得到的。我们发现回旋加速器频率对拓扑电荷和磁场具有重要的依赖性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 螺旋是低频圆极化横向电磁模式，在存在静磁场的情况下在三维传导系统中传播。在这里，我们使用半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论研究了具有拓扑电荷 (J=1,2,) 和 (3) 的无间隙多外尔半金属 (mWSM) 中的螺旋激发。我们将贝里曲率和轨道磁矩校正合并到准粒子动力学中，并确定弱静磁场存在下的光导张量。单外尔系统、双外尔系统和三外尔系统的纵向电导率是通过分析获得的，而横向电导率是在与螺旋传播相关的低频区域中通过数值计算得到的。我们发现回旋加速器频率对拓扑电荷和磁场具有重要的依赖性。由此产生的螺旋色散保留了对波矢量的特征二次依赖关系，而轴子电动力学贡献生成了一个额外的线性项。我们进一步表明，轴子项提高了零波矢量处有隙集体模式的简并性，所得模式频率由依赖于 (J) 的等离子体频率决定。这些结果表明，螺旋响应提供了多外尔半金属独特电动力学特性的探针。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《多外尔半金属中的螺旋》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Hidden entropic order of emergent charges in a classical Ampère spin liquid
full_list.title_zh: 经典安培自旋液体中涌现电荷的隐藏熵序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical spin liquids are characterized by an extensive number of ground-state configurations. Coulomb spin liquids have, in this ground-state manifold, a divergence-free local constraint, which gives dipolar correlations and pinch points in the structure factor. Recently, models with a complementary ground-state constraint, defined by a zero-circulation constraint (Ampère's law), have been proposed. While classical Coulomb spin liquids forbid emergent charges, their Ampère counterparts leave the charges unconstrained. Here we study an Ising Ampère model on the octochlore lattice. The ground states obey a Gauss law for an antisymmetric rank-two field, i.e., three coupled two-dimensional Gauss laws, which are expected to produce pinch points in the structure factor. Nevertheless, maximal charges, vertices with all six arrows in or out, spontaneously accumulate on one of the two sublattices of the cubic lattice, with disordered signs. This order has a purely entropic origin; it washes out the pinch-point singularities at large scales, produces no magnetic Bragg peaks, and coexists with an extensive entropy. The system enters into this sublattice long-range ordered state through a continuous transition in what seems to be the three-dimensional Ising universality class. Moreover, the state has no magnetic order; it is even under time reversal: it is a hidden, entropic order within the Ampère manifold. Thus, a system whose Gauss law would predict an algebraic spin liquid becomes, through a non-magnetic ordering transition, a partially ordered short-range spin liquid. Our study is based on a combination of the constraint-vector theory, exact bounds and enumeration, and Monte Carlo, Wang-Landau, and parallel-tempering simulations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 经典自旋液体的特点是具有大量的基态构型。在这个基态流形中，库仑自旋液体具有无散度局部约束，它给出了结构因子中的偶极相关性和夹点。最近，提出了具有由零循环约束（安培定律）定义的互补基态约束的模型。虽然经典的库仑自旋液体禁止紧急电荷，但它们的安培对应物却使电荷不受限制。在这里，我们研究八氯石晶格上的伊辛安培模型。基态服从反对称二阶场的高斯定律，即三个耦合的二维高斯定律，预计它们会在结构因子中产生夹点。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 经典自旋液体的特点是具有大量的基态构型。在这个基态流形中，库仑自旋液体具有无散度局部约束，它给出了结构因子中的偶极相关性和夹点。最近，提出了具有由零循环约束（安培定律）定义的互补基态约束的模型。虽然经典的库仑自旋液体禁止紧急电荷，但它们的安培对应物却使电荷不受限制。在这里，我们研究八氯石晶格上的伊辛安培模型。基态服从反对称二阶场的高斯定律，即三个耦合的二维高斯定律，预计它们会在结构因子中产生夹点。然而，最大电荷，即所有六个箭头都进出的顶点，会自发地累积在立方晶格的两个子晶格之一上，并且符号无序。这个秩序有一个纯粹的熵起源；它在大尺度上消除了夹点奇点，不产生磁性布拉格峰，并且与广泛的熵共存。系统通过看似三维伊辛普适性类的连续转变进入这种亚晶格长程有序状态。而且，国家没有磁力秩序；即使在时间反转的情况下也是如此：它是安培流形内隐藏的熵序。因此，高斯定律预测代数自旋液体的系统通过非磁性有序转变变成部分有序的短程自旋液体。我们的研究基于约束向量理论、精确界限和枚举以及蒙特卡罗、Wang-Landau 和平行回火模拟的组合。

full_list.title_en: Hydrogen sublattice in LaH₁₂: structural stability and possible ordering motifs
full_list.title_zh: LaH₁₂ 中的氢亚晶格：结构稳定性和可能的有序基序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lanthanum polyhydrides, synthesized under extreme pressure, exhibit near-room-temperature superconductivity. Finding a precise arrangement of the hydrogen sublattice that is critical for understanding the strong electron-phonon coupling remains experimentally unresolved due to the small X-ray scattering form factor of hydrogen atoms. In this work, we attempt to computationally reconstruct hydrogen sublattices of the LaH₁₂ at 100-200 GPa combining unconstrained evolutionary searches and structure generation with fixed lanthanum sublattice. By implementing a similarity metric, we screen the computationally generated configurations against experimental powder X-ray diffraction data. We specifically identify the trigonal Rbar3-LaH₁₂ and pseudo-hexagonal C222₁-La₂H₂₄ phases, which demonstrate close agreement with the experimental X-ray diffraction data. First-principles calculations confirm the metallic and superconducting nature of these hydrides. Crucially, our lattice dynamics analysis using the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA) indicates that these structures are dynamically stable. We reveal the presence of molecular H₂ units and soft phonon modes in the trigonal LaH₁₂ that suppresses superconductivity (T_c ge 30 K), while the hydrogen clathrate network in the C222₁ phase drives strong electron-phonon interactions, yielding the coupling parameters of λapprox 1.83, ωₗₒg approx 87.5 meV and transition temperature of T_capprox 150 K at 150 GPa.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在极压下合成的多氢化镧表现出接近室温的超导性。由于氢原子的 X 射线散射形状因子较小，寻找氢亚晶格的精确排列对于理解强电子声子耦合至关重要，这一问题在实验上仍未得到解决。在这项工作中，我们尝试结合无约束演化搜索和固定镧亚晶格的结构生成，在 100-200 GPa 下计算重建 LaH₁ 的氢亚晶格。通过实施相似性度量，我们根据实验粉末 X 射线衍射数据筛选计算生成的配置。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在极压下合成的多氢化镧表现出接近室温的超导性。由于氢原子的 X 射线散射形状因子较小，寻找氢亚晶格的精确排列对于理解强电子声子耦合至关重要，这一问题在实验上仍未得到解决。在这项工作中，我们尝试结合无约束演化搜索和固定镧亚晶格的结构生成，在 100-200 GPa 下计算重建 LaH₁ 的氢亚晶格。通过实施相似性度量，我们根据实验粉末 X 射线衍射数据筛选计算生成的配置。我们特别鉴定了三角 Rbar3-LaH₁ 和伪六方 C222₁-La 2H 24 相，这与实验 X 射线衍射数据非常吻合。第一性原理计算证实了这些氢化物的金属和超导性质。至关重要的是，我们使用随机自洽谐波近似（SSHA）进行的晶格动力学分析表明这些结构是动态稳定的。我们揭示了三角LaH₁₂中分子H2单元和软声子模式的存在，抑制了超导性（T_c ge 30 K），而C222₁相中的氢笼形网络驱动了强电子-声子相互作用，产生了耦合参数λapprox 1.83，ωₗₒg约87.5 meV和T_capprox 150的转变温度K 在 150 GPa 下。

full_list.title_en: Hyperbolic Nanocavities for Single-Molecule Vibrational Strong Coupling
full_list.title_zh: 用于单分子振动强耦合的双曲纳米腔
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06240v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hyperbolic phonon polaritons (HPhPs) in low-loss anisotropic materials such as hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) provide extreme sub-diffractional field confinement in the mid-infrared, making them attractive for enhancing the interaction of light with molecular vibrations. Collective vibrational strong coupling between molecular ensembles and HPhPs has already been demonstrated in extended slabs. Reaching this regime with a single molecule, however, remains a major challenge, and would provide a platform for investigating how vacuum electromagnetic fields influence molecular dynamics and chemical reactivity. Here, we show theoretically that single-molecule vibrational strong coupling can be reached in hBN nanocavities that laterally confine HPhPs within a finite volume. Combining full-wave electromagnetic simulations with the few-mode quantization approach, we find that these nanocavities support a rich set of asymmetric resonances that strongly enhance the local spectral density, with frequencies that follow from simple HPhP ray trajectories and can be tuned through the cavity aspect ratio. We identify resonances with quality factors of about 600 and effective mode volumes of |Vₑff| sim 10⁻⁷λ³, sufficient for single-molecule strong coupling with vibrational transitions with dipole moments on the order of 1,D. These results establish hyperbolic nanocavities as a promising platform for single-molecule vibrational strong coupling and open new routes toward the local control of vibrational dynamics and molecular energy flow.
full_list.abstract_zh: 六方氮化硼 (hBN) 等低损耗各向异性材料中的双曲声子极化激元 (HPhP) 在中红外区域提供极端的亚衍射场限制，使其在增强光与分子振动的相互作用方面具有吸引力。分子系综和 HPhP 之间的集体振动强耦合已经在扩展平板中得到证明。然而，用单分子达到这种状态仍然是一个重大挑战，并且将为研究真空电磁场如何影响分子动力学和化学反应性提供一个平台。在这里，我们从理论上证明，在将 HPhP 横向限制在有限体积内的 hBN 纳米腔中可以实现单分子振动强耦合。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于单分子振动强耦合的双曲纳米腔》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Interplay between Spin Stripes and Pairing Crossover in the Bilayer Hubbard Model
full_list.title_zh: 双层哈伯德模型中旋转条纹与配对交叉之间的相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether d-wave or s_±-wave pairing prevails in the bilayer nickelate ceLa3Ni2O7 remains unresolved, and how its observed spin order and magnetic excitations relate to the pairing mechanism is unclear. Here, we use finite-temperature determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of a minimal bilayer Hubbard model to investigate pairing competition at strong interlayer coupling, where intralayer and interlayer antiferromagnetic correlations have comparable strengths. We find that spin stripes develop spontaneously with increasing hole doping, accompanied by a crossover of the dominant pairing symmetry from d-wave to s_±-wave. The crossover tracks the changing relative strengths of the spin correlations, with the interlayer correlations overtaking their intralayer counterparts in magnitude. Concomitantly, the dynamical spin structure factor exhibits a momentum-dependent reorganization of the magnetic excitations, consistent with fluctuating spin stripes. Our results identify the structure of spin fluctuations as a key link between spin stripes and pairing competition, offering a minimal-model perspective for understanding ceLa3Ni2O7.
full_list.abstract_zh: 双层镍酸盐 ceLa3Ni2O7 中是否存在 d 波或 s_± 波配对仍未解决，并且其观察到的自旋顺序和磁激发与配对机制之间的关系尚不清楚。在这里，我们使用最小双层哈伯德模型的有限温度行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟来研究强层间耦合下的配对竞争，其中层内和层间反铁磁相关性具有相当的强度。我们发现，随着空穴掺杂的增加，自旋条纹会自发形成，并伴随着主要配对对称性从 d 波到 s_± 波的交叉。交叉跟踪自旋相关性相对强度的变化，层间相关性在幅度上超过了层内相关性。

full_list.title_en: Inverse Chiral Phonon Zeeman Effect in Noncentrosymmetric Crystals
full_list.title_zh: 非中心对称晶体中的反手性声子塞曼效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.12763v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a quantized effective theory of the inverse chiral phonon Zeeman effect in noncentrosymmetric crystals. Within micropolar elasticity, coupled translational displacements and microrotations give rise to intrinsically chiral phonons, which generate an elliptically polarized internal magnetic field through dynamical piezoelectricity. Provided that electronic screening is incomplete, this field acts as an effective longitudinal Zeeman field on electronic spins, driving a Floquet response for localized states and a stationary adiabatic band splitting for itinerant electrons, leading to macroscopic spin polarization. In contrast to earlier discussions based on nearly degenerate axial optical modes or externally driven circular lattice motion, the present mechanism relies on finite-wave-number truly chiral phonons whose counter-rotating branches are intrinsically split by crystal chirality. Quantization is introduced to define the single-phonon magnetic-field scale, coherent-state enhancement, and magnetic chirality in a controlled manner. The results establish a purely lattice-driven mechanism for the inverse chiral phonon Zeeman effect in noncentrosymmetric crystals.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了非中心对称晶体中反手性声子塞曼效应的量子化有效理论。在微极性弹性内，耦合的平移位移和微旋转产生本质上的手性声子，其通过动态压电产生椭圆极化的内部磁场。如果电子屏蔽不完整，则该场充当电子自旋的有效纵向塞曼场，驱动局域态的弗洛奎特响应和流动电子的固定绝热能带分裂，导致宏观自旋极化。与早期基于近简并轴向光学模式或外部驱动的圆形晶格运动的讨论相反，本机制依赖于有限波数真正手性声子，其反向旋转分支本质上被晶体手性分裂。引入量化以受控方式定义单声子磁场尺度、相干态增强和磁手性。

full_list.title_en: Majorana-like Josephson branch structure in one-dimensional transport of cold atoms
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Majorana-like Josephson branch structure in one-dimensional transport of cold atoms
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study phase-controlled transport through a one-dimensional channel of attractively interacting fermions connecting two three-dimensional BCS reservoirs. The competition between channel phase stiffness and pair tunnelling at the two contacts results in the emergence of two 4π-periodic families of stationary states, characterised by symmetric or asymmetric phase drops at the boundaries. Advancing the reservoir phase difference by 2π exchanges these families so that the equilibrium energy remains 2π periodic, while the 4π  periodicity might be attained in a diabatic regime. This structure admits a formal description in terms of two boundary Majorana operators, combining into a nonlocal fermion mode. Renormalization-group analysis shows that quantum fluctuations and phase slips are suppressed in the zero-temperature thermodynamic limit, preserving the branch crossings. The predicted branch exchange, metastable currents, and sweep-rate-dependent switching provide experimentally testable signatures of Majorana-like Josephson branch physics in a gapless interacting channel.

full_list.title_en: Millikelvin magnetometry up to 30~T using a multi-cross micro-Hall sensor

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a multi-cross micro-Hall sensor fabricated from an MBE-grown GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructure for high-sensitivity magnetometry. The device enables dc magnetization measurements at temperatures down to sim15~mK and in dc magnetic fields up to 30 T. Bulk samples with dimensions ranging from 100~μm to 1~mm can be measured with a resolution better than 1~μT with a 1~μA excitation at 13.77 Hz. Test-of-performance measurements were carried out by probing the field-dependent magnetization plateaus of the triangular-lattice quantum magnet K₂Co₂(SeO₃)₃ at 20~mK, the antiferromagnetic transition of K₃GdTe₂O₉ near 220 mK via temperature-dependent magnetization, and the quantum oscillations in a ruthenium single crystal. A simple and reliable sample-mounting setup that ensures reproducible magnetic measurements is provided.

full_list.title_en: Ni ordering in the van der Waals gap of Ni-intercalated 2H-NbS₂: from disorder through 2×2 and sqrt3×sqrt3 order to stripe order
full_list.title_zh: Ni插层2H-NbS2范德华间隙中的Ni排序：从无序到2×2和sqrt3×sqrt3有序到条纹有序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a synchrotron x-ray diffraction study of Ni-intercalated 2H-NbS₂ over the range 0.18 le x le 0.57, with Ni contents measured by energy-dispersive x-ray spectroscopy. Powder diffraction on the whole series shows that the NbS₂ host is preserved, while the Ni ions in the van der Waals gap evolve from a disordered arrangement to 2×2 order at x=1/4 and sqrt3×sqrt3 order at x=1/3, through a range where both motifs coexist, to an orthorhombic stripe-type order at x=0.57. The in-plane lattice parameter increases with Ni content, whereas the interlayer spacing remains nearly constant except for a pronounced minimum at x=1/4, which density-functional calculations reproduce for the ordered structure. Single-crystal diffraction on the two commensurate phases shows that the x=1/4 structure, with Ni on a single site and a trimerized Nb lattice, is free of stacking faults, whereas the chiral x=1/3 structure contains Ni on the nominally empty site, inversion twins and stacking faults of the Ni layers. The comparison between powders and crystals shows that grinding mainly degrades the stacking of the Ni layers. These results establish the structural phase diagram of NiₓNbS₂ and the intercalant disorder to be taken into account in the interpretation of its magnetic properties.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了在 0.18 le x le 0.57 范围内插层 Ni 的 2H-NbS2 的同步加速器 X 射线衍射研究，并通过能量色散 X 射线光谱测量了 Ni 含量。整个系列的粉末衍射表明，NbS2主体被保留，而范德华间隙中的Ni离子从无序排列演变为x=1/4处的2×2有序和x=1/3处的sqrt3×sqrt3有序，经过两个图案共存的范围，演变为x=0.57处的正交条纹型有序。

full_list.title_en: Noise-Induced Topology in Chiral Quantum Walks
full_list.title_zh: 手性量子行走中的噪声诱导拓扑
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05471v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Noise typically destroys quantum coherence and washes out transport phenomena that rely on interference. Chiral quantum walks are a case in point: a particle hopping on a lattice threaded by a magnetic flux can spread asymmetrically due to interference between paths, an asymmetry that noise is expected to erase. Remarkably, we find that the most ubiquitous noise -- random fluctuations of on-site energies (dephasing) -- instead renders this asymmetry topologically robust. The density profile develops a skewness that grows in time while its center stays fixed, and in a finite chain the late-time relaxation modes pile up at one edge: a skin effect lacking the drift of conventional non-Hermitian skin effects. With multiple sites per unit cell, the dephasing strength alone can cause a topological phase transition, reversing the asymmetry. On a flux ladder with noisy rung hopping, the noise causes a drift of rung coherences, a quantum ratchet with no classical counterpart. Underlying these effects, the noise-averaged dynamics is an interacting (generically non-integrable) Lindbladian that remains analytically tractable. The modes governing late-time relaxation are bound states of the noise-induced interaction and form a band with a point gap, absent both without noise and under postselection, whose winding number fixes the direction of the asymmetry. These effects are within reach of several experimental platforms, including synthetic lattices, superconducting qubits, and optical lattices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 噪声通常会破坏量子相干性并消除依赖于干扰的传输现象。手性量子行走就是一个很好的例子：在磁通量穿过的晶格上跳跃的粒子可能会由于路径之间的干扰而不对称地传播，而噪声有望消除这种不对称性。值得注意的是，我们发现最普遍的噪声——现场能量的随机波动（相移）——反而使这种不对称性在拓扑上变得鲁棒。密度分布会产生一种偏度，该偏度随着时间的推移而增长，而其中心保持固定，并且在有限链中，后期弛豫模式堆积在一个边缘：一种趋肤效应，缺乏传统非厄米趋肤效应的漂移。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 噪声通常会破坏量子相干性并消除依赖于干扰的传输现象。手性量子行走就是一个很好的例子：在磁通量穿过的晶格上跳跃的粒子可能会由于路径之间的干扰而不对称地传播，而噪声有望消除这种不对称性。值得注意的是，我们发现最普遍的噪声——现场能量的随机波动（相移）——反而使这种不对称性在拓扑上变得鲁棒。密度分布会产生一种偏度，该偏度随着时间的推移而增长，而其中心保持固定，并且在有限链中，后期弛豫模式堆积在一个边缘：一种趋肤效应，缺乏传统非厄米趋肤效应的漂移。由于每个晶胞有多个位点，仅相移强度就可以引起拓扑相变，扭转不对称性。在具有噪声梯级跳变的磁通梯上，噪声会导致梯级相干性漂移，这是一种没有经典对应物的量子棘轮。在这些效应的基础上，噪声平均动力学是一个相互作用的（一般不可积的）林布拉德，但仍然易于分析处理。控制后期弛豫的模式是噪声引起的相互作用的束缚态，并形成具有点间隙的带，在没有噪声和后选择的情况下都不存在，其缠绕数固定了不对称的方向。这些效应可以通过多个实验平台实现，包括合成晶格、超导量子位和光学晶格。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《手性量子行走中的噪声诱导拓扑》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Quantitatively Probing the Tilt Angle Failures in 4D-STEM Polarisation Analysis
full_list.title_zh: 定量探测 4D-STEM 偏振分析中的倾斜角故障
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) is increasingly used to map polarisation in ferroic textures such as domain walls, vortices, merons and skyrmions. These textures are accompanied by local strain, lattice rotation and misorientation, which also modulate the diffraction features used to infer polar order. Even small deviations from the zone axis can therefore produce contrast that is indistinguishable from a polarisation signal. Here we quantify the tilt sensitivity of two polarisation-sensitive signals, diffraction disc intensity and Kikuchi band intensity, in three ferroelectrics with distinct polar distortions: PbTiO3, BaTiO3 and Cu3B7O13Cl boracite. We find that tilts of only 0.01-0.05 degrees reverse most Friedel-pair disc asymmetries, and even the most robust disc pairs reverse by 0.04 degrees in BaTiO3, 0.14 degrees in PbTiO3 and 0.18 degrees in boracite, producing contrast equal and opposite to that of the polarisation. Kikuchi band contrast is the only signal that reports absolute polarity without knowledge of the specimen thickness, but it does so only up to 0.09 degrees in PbTiO3, 0.015 degrees in BaTiO3 and 0.02 degrees in boracite. From these results we define tilt tolerances for each signal and material, and propose practical criteria for distinguishing polarisation contrast from misorientation. The analysis also applies to scanning electron microscopy-based diffraction, including electron backscatter diffraction.
full_list.abstract_zh: 四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 越来越多地用于绘制磁畴壁、涡旋、半子和斯格明子等铁质纹理中的偏振图。这些纹理伴随着局部应变、晶格旋转和取向错误，它们也会调制用于推断极序的衍射特征。因此，即使与区域轴的微小偏差也会产生与偏振信号无法区分的对比度。在这里，我们量化了三种具有明显极性畸变的铁电体：PbTiO3、BaTiO3 和 Cu3B7O13Cl 方硼石中两种偏振敏感信号、衍射盘强度和菊池带强度的倾斜灵敏度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 四维扫描透射电子显微镜 (4D-STEM) 越来越多地用于绘制磁畴壁、涡旋、半子和斯格明子等铁质纹理中的偏振图。这些纹理伴随着局部应变、晶格旋转和取向错误，它们也会调制用于推断极序的衍射特征。因此，即使与区域轴的微小偏差也会产生与偏振信号无法区分的对比度。在这里，我们量化了三种具有明显极性畸变的铁电体：PbTiO3、BaTiO3 和 Cu3B7O13Cl 方硼石中两种偏振敏感信号、衍射盘强度和菊池带强度的倾斜灵敏度。我们发现，仅 0.01-0.05 度的倾斜就可以逆转大多数弗里德尔对圆盘不对称性，即使是最坚固的圆盘对，BaTiO3 中也可逆转 0.04 度，PbTiO3 中逆转 0.14 度，方硼石中逆转 0.18 度，产生与偏振相同或相反的对比度。菊池带对比度是在不知道样品厚度的情况下报告绝对极性的唯一信号，但在 PbTiO3 中只能达到 0.09 度，在 BaTiO3 中只能达到 0.015 度，在方硼石中只能达到 0.02 度。根据这些结果，我们定义了每种信号和材料的倾斜容差，并提出了区分偏振对比度和定向错误的实用标准。该分析还适用于基于扫描电子显微镜的衍射，包括电子背散射衍射。

full_list.title_en: Quantum Noise Spectroscopy of Criticality in an Atomically Thin Magnet
full_list.title_zh: 原子薄磁体临界的量子噪声光谱
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2407.05614v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The universality class of a phase transition dictates the behavior of low-frequency and long-wavelength critical fluctuations in a material. Studying these dynamics in thin magnetic insulators, however, remains challenging; an experimental probe must be sensitive to low-frequency, long-wavelength fluctuations while navigating the sample's small volume, inherent inhomogeneities, and fabrication limitations. Using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, we demonstrate T₂ (spin-decoherence) noise magnetometry as a direct and quantitative probe of critical dynamics in a tri-layer sample of CrSBr, a two-dimensional van der Waals magnet. We observe a sharp increase in the decoherence rate of the NV spin ensemble at the sample's critical temperature, highlighting our probe's sensitivity to critical fluctuations. We demonstrate that the behavior of the NV spin decoherence rate below the critical temperature is inconsistent with fluctuations due to XY criticality in 2D CrSBr. Next, by simulating the NV spin decoherence dynamics using noise models for an Ising-type transition and fitting to our data, we quantitatively measure the dynamical and the correlation length critical exponents (z and ν) and demonstrate that the observed fluctuations strongly deviate from those predicted by the short-range Ising universality class. Together, these observations indicate that the transition is Ising-like but modified by long-range dipolar interactions, emphasizing the importance of easy-axis anisotropy and long-range interactions for understanding magnetism in 2D CrSBr. Our work establishes T₂ noise magnetometry as a quantitative probe of critical dynamics in 2D materials, opening a new avenue for studying strongly correlated phenomena at the atomically thin limit.
full_list.abstract_zh: 相变的普遍性类别决定了材料中低频和长波长临界波动的行为。然而，研究薄磁绝缘体中的这些动力学仍然具有挑战性。实验探针必须对低频、长波长波动敏感，同时应对样品的小体积、固有的不均匀性和制造限制。利用金刚石中的氮空位 (NV) 中心，我们展示了 T2（自旋退相干）噪声磁力测定法作为二维范德华磁体 CrSBr 三层样品中临界动力学的直接定量探针。我们观察到样品临界温度下 NV 自旋系综的退相干率急剧增加，突出了我们的探针对临界波动的敏感性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 相变的普遍性类别决定了材料中低频和长波长临界波动的行为。然而，研究薄磁绝缘体中的这些动力学仍然具有挑战性。实验探针必须对低频、长波长波动敏感，同时应对样品的小体积、固有的不均匀性和制造限制。利用金刚石中的氮空位 (NV) 中心，我们展示了 T2（自旋退相干）噪声磁力测定法作为二维范德华磁体 CrSBr 三层样品中临界动力学的直接定量探针。我们观察到样品临界温度下 NV 自旋系综的退相干率急剧增加，突出了我们的探针对临界波动的敏感性。我们证明了 NV 自旋退相干率低于临界温度的行为与 2D CrSBr 中 XY 临界值引起的波动不一致。接下来，通过使用伊辛型跃迁的噪声模型模拟 NV 自旋退相干动力学并拟合我们的数据，我们定量测量了动力学和相关长度临界指数（z 和 ν），并证明观察到的波动与短程伊辛普适性类预测的波动强烈偏离。总之，这些观察结果表明，转变是类似伊辛的转变，但受到长程偶极相互作用的影响，强调了易轴各向异性和长程相互作用对于理解二维 CrSBr 中磁性的重要性。我们的工作将 T2 噪声磁力测量建立为二维材料临界动力学的定量探针，为研究原子薄极限下的强相关现象开辟了一条新途径。

full_list.title_en: Raychaudhuri-Ehlers Kinematics on Quantum State-Space: Caustics and Extrinsic Quantum Geometry
full_list.title_zh: 量子态空间上的 Raychaudhuri-Ehlers 运动学：焦散和外在量子几何
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05499v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum mechanics is inherently geometric in that the pure states form a curved complex manifold and the Schrödinger evolution defines a Hamiltonian flow on this space. Geometry identifies constraints on flows on quantum state-space that hold independently of their microscopic realization. We uncover such universal behavior in families of geodesic paths on the quantum state-space using the Raychaudhuri-Ehlers equations. We show that the complex structure leads to tidal anisotropy in the curvature, and for Hilbert space dimension N≥3, complete point-emitted geodesic bundles necessarily develop shear and undergo direction-selective focusing at finite distance. We give these geometric results an information-theoretic interpretation in terms of fidelity susceptibility and quantum Fisher information. For ground-state manifolds constrained by physical parameters, we resolve the tidal curvature into Berry-curvature-dependent ambient tides and contributions from extrinsic bending within the full ambient state space. We further relate extrinsic bending to variations in the unitary generator of motion along intrinsic geodesics. We present exact many-body geometric results for the transverse-field XY spin chain. The product structure of the ground state leads to an exact cancellation of the ambient tide, including its Berry-curvature enhancement, by extrinsic curvature contributions. At the zero-field Ising point, we obtain exact results at finite size and show that the shear source for anisotropy-directed motion is entirely extrinsic relative to the full many-body state-space. For the metric in the thermodynamic limit, the geodesic families exhibit repeated A₂ fold catastrophes inside the ferromagnetic phase. Our framework thus separates universal state-space effects from those of physical restrictions and exposes their consequences in a paradigmatic many-body system.

full_list.title_en: Reduced Order Hysteretic Magnetization Model for Composite Superconductors
full_list.title_zh: 复合超导体减阶迟滞磁化模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2409.13653v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we propose the Reduced Order Hysteretic Magnetization (ROHM) model to describe the magnetization and instantaneous power loss of composite superconductors subject to time-varying magnetic fields. Once the parameters of the ROHM model are fixed based on reference simulations, it allows to directly compute the macroscopic response of composite superconductors without the need to solve the detailed current density distribution. It can then be used as part of a homogenization method in large-scale superconducting models to significantly reduce the computational effort compared to detailed simulations. In this contribution, we focus on the case of a strand with twisted superconducting filaments subject to a time-varying transverse magnetic field. We propose two variations of the ROHM model: (i) a rate-independent model that reproduces hysteresis in the filaments, and (ii) a rate-dependent model that generalizes the first level by also reproducing dynamic effects due to coupling and eddy currents. We then describe the implementation and inclusion of the ROHM model in a finite element framework, discuss how to deduce the model parameters, and finally demonstrate the capabilities of the approach in terms of accuracy and efficiency over a wide range of excitation frequencies and amplitudes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出了还原阶滞后磁化强度（ ROHM ）模型来描述复合超导体在时变磁场作用下的磁化强度和瞬时功率损失。一旦基于参考模拟确定了ROHM模型的参数，它就可以直接计算复合超导体的宏观响应，而无需求解详细的电流密度分布。然后，它可以作为大规模超导模型中均匀化方法的一部分，与详细模拟相比，显着减少计算量。在本文中，我们重点介绍了具有扭曲超导细丝的股线受到时变横向磁场的情况。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了还原阶滞后磁化强度（ ROHM ）模型来描述复合超导体在时变磁场作用下的磁化强度和瞬时功率损失。一旦基于参考模拟确定了ROHM模型的参数，它就可以直接计算复合超导体的宏观响应，而无需求解详细的电流密度分布。然后，它可以作为大规模超导模型中均匀化方法的一部分，与详细模拟相比，显着减少计算量。在本文中，我们重点介绍了具有扭曲超导细丝的股线受到时变横向磁场的情况。我们提出了罗姆模型的两种变体： （ i ）再现细丝中滞后的速率无关模型，以及（ ii ）通过再现由耦合和涡流引起的动态效应来推广第一级的速率相关模型。然后，我们描述了ROHM模型在有限元框架中的实现和包含，讨论了如何推导模型参数，并最终演示了该方法在宽激励频率和幅度范围内的精度和效率方面的能力。

full_list.title_en: Spin swapping mediated by spin-orbital textures in centrosymmetric multiorbital materials
full_list.title_zh: 中心对称多轨道材料中自旋轨道纹理介导的自旋交换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin swapping converts a primary spin current into a secondary one by interchanging its flow and spin-polarization directions, attributed to spin-orbit scattering or spin-band splitting. Here we uncover a fundamentally distinct route to spin swapping arising from the orbital degree of freedom in the spin pumping to centrosymmetric multiorbital materials without spin-band splitting. When the dynamical proximity ferromagnet injects a longitudinal spin current flowing normal to the interface, spin-orbit-entangled orbital textures redirect the injected spins into longitudinal and transverse orbital currents. Their subsequent conversion back to the spin sector generates transverse spin currents with propagation and polarization directions swapped relative to the primary spin current. The swapping efficiency achieves 50% for Ge and Si. Governed by a fourth-rank tensor constrained by crystalline symmetry and without requiring spin-orbit scattering or inversion symmetry breaking, our finding reveals spin-orbital textures as hidden intermediate channels of spin swapping with unexplored material choices and functionalities.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋交换通过交换其流动方向和自旋极化方向，将初级自旋电流转换为次级自旋电流，这归因于自旋轨道散射或自旋带分裂。在这里，我们发现了一条从根本上不同的自旋交换路径，该路径是由自旋泵浦到中心对称多轨道材料的轨道自由度引起的，而没有自旋带分裂。当动态邻近铁磁体注入垂直于界面流动的纵向自旋电流时，自旋轨道纠缠轨道纹理将注入的自旋重定向为纵向和横向轨道电流。它们随后转换回自旋扇区，产生横向自旋电流，其传播和偏振方向相对于主自旋电流交换。 Ge和Si的交换效率达到50%。

full_list.title_en: The quantized Hall effect knows which way the current flows: mirror covariance and rectification in a laterally asymmetric Hall bar
full_list.title_zh: 量子化霍尔效应知道电流的流动方向：横向不对称霍尔条中的镜像协方差和整流
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.06004v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantized Hall effect is the textbook emblem of universality: a resistance fixed by h/e², apparently indifferent to the shape of the sample, to its edges and to the direction of the current. That indifference is only half true. The plateau value is universal; the plateau is not. In a gate-defined Hall bar with one hard and one soft edge, reversing the current moves the plateau edge, and exchanging the edges reverses the move. We identify the symmetry that forces this. Because a perpendicular field breaks time reversal, the relevant operation is the in-plane C₂ rotation; within the self-consistent screening model it gives the covariance relation R_α[B,Vcₒₙf(x),I]=R_α[B,Vcₒₙf(-x),-I], exact deep in the nonlinear regime and independent of linear response or microscopic reversibility. It predicts a rectification that is odd under exchange of the gate voltages and reverses with the magnetic field. The field-reversal test leaves the frozen lateral disorder untouched, so it holds for a single sample; it has not yet been performed. A further measurement, collapsing one incompressible strip, discriminates between co-directed and chiral pictures of the current. Self-consistent calculations show the soft-edge strip widening from 69 to 106,nm on current reversal, moving the Hall resistance from 0.940 to 0.999994,h/2e² within a bounded window in magnetic field. The effect is a gate-tunable vector-product nonreciprocity, not magnetochiral anisotropy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子化霍尔效应是普遍性的教科书标志：由 h/e² 固定的电阻，显然与样品的形状、边缘和电流方向无关。这种冷漠只说对了一半。高原值具有普遍性；高原则不然。在具有一个硬边缘和一个软边缘的门定义霍尔条中，反转电流会移动平台边缘，而交换边缘会反转移动。我们确定了迫使这一点的对称性。由于垂直场破坏了时间反转，因此相关操作是面内 C2 旋转；

full_list.title_en: Topological localization in unentangled random braids
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Topological localization in unentangled random braids
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.05721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In 2015, P. Serna, G. Bunin, and A. Nahum numerically investigated fluctuations in a bunch of unentangled random threads. They showed that fluctuations of an individual thread in a braid are qualitatively different from those of a thread embedded in a medium of fixed parallel lines. In particular, Serna et al. observed a logarithmic increase in the average transverse span, left<|x_N|right>, of a thread with polymer length, N. This behavior highlights the collective nature of topological interactions, in which each polymer fluctuates and constrains the motion of the others. Studying this problem both numerically and analytically, we propose the following interpretation: the logarithmic regime is transient, and sufficiently long polymers exhibit topological localization, where left<|x_N|right> approaches a finite limit at N→infty. Unlike localization induced by quenched external disorder, this phenomenon arises solely from collective topological constraints. We study braids within a locally free approximation and support the localization by analytical investigation of Brownian bridges on the asymptotic Cayley graph of a locally free group. We further conjecture that topologically induced localization emerges as a phase transition: for a small number of threads, n sim 2div 5, the span, left<|x_N|right>, grows algebraically, with the usual scaling left<|x_N|right>sim N¹/⁴ at Ngg 1; by contrast, for sufficiently large n, each thread in a long braid (Ngg 1) asymptotically localizes, approaching left<|x_N|right>sim const.

core_items.title_en: Temperature-Dependent Ion Dynamics in Argyrodite Superionic Conductor Li₆PS₅Cl with Fine-Tuned MACE Foundation Model
core_items.title_zh: 使用微调的 MACE 基础模型研究银铜矿超离子导体 Li₆PS₅Cl 中温度相关的离子动力学
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.05946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid growth of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIP), particularly the foundational models for materials chemistry, such as MACE, has significantly strengthened our capabilities in studying the complex dynamics of materials through statistical sampling. Here, by performing molecular dynamics with a fine-tuned MACE model, that are further combined with essential dynamics analysis, a tool that is commonly applied in (bio)molecular simulations, we examine the temperature-dependent ion dynamics in a prototypical inorganic solid superionic conductor, namely argyrodite Li₆PS₅Cl. Our analyses show clear localised phonon-like dynamics for Li⁺ ions below 500 K with trajectories lying in a low-dimensional manifold that is highly nonlinear, which is opposite to the case in the high-temperature (sim800 K) end. Between 500-700 K, the system exhibit strong competition in the dynamics between the Li⁺ and framework ions, that are reflected in both the eigenspectrum and the projected low-dimensional embeddings characterising these dynamics not showing a simple monotonic dependency upon rising temperatures, and is further supported by investigations employing Langevin dynamics that systematically examine how damping the framework motions affects the dynamics of the Li⁺ ions, thanks to the computational efficiency provided by MLIP. This work thus contributes towards the broader theoretical and data-driven framework for studying the lattice dynamics of solids.
core_items.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的快速发展，特别是材料化学的基础模型（例如 MACE），显着增强了我们通过统计采样研究材料复杂动力学的能力。在这里，通过使用微调的 MACE 模型执行分子动力学，并进一步与基本动力学分析（生物）分子模拟中常用的工具相结合，我们检查了原型无机固体超离子导体（即银汞矿 Li₆PS₅Cl）中温度依赖性离子动力学。

core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine Learning the Complete Active-Space Wavefunction Reconstruction
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.06779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials enable multireference-quality reaction dynamics but do not retain the electronic structure underlying the predicted energies and forces. Recovering this information by independently performing complete active space self-consistent field (CASSCF) calculations is both expensive and potentially inconsistent. We introduce the Complete Active-Space Wave Function Reconstruction (CAS-WR) model, which learns the geometry-dependent electronic structure from CASSCF data and reconstructs the CAS wave function without repeated orbital optimization. Combined with uncertainty-based active learning, CAS-WR is demonstrated for the Diels--Alder reaction and ceTiC+-catalyzed C--H activation. The approach enables trajectory-resolved analysis of multiconfigurational electronic structure across reactive ensembles. Preliminary applications to excited-state proton transfer and transition-metal photocatalysis suggest that CAS-WR can provide a general route toward recovering electronic structure along complex ground- and excited-state reactive dynamics.

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《使用不确定性感知神经网络对磁性材料特性进行建模》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Floquet-Volkov spin polarization in spin-degenerate Antiferromagnets
core_items.title_zh: 自旋简并反铁磁体中的 Floquet-Volkov 自旋极化
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.05856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic driving enables ultrafast control of electronic structures in solids through the formation of photon-dressed Floquet-Bloch states. However, the measured photoemission spectra are influenced not only by these states but also by their interference with Volkov-dressed outgoing photoelectrons. Here, we demonstrate that Floquet-Volkov interference can generate spin-polarized photoemission in a collinear antiferromagnetic Dirac model without spin-orbit coupling (SOC). An in-plane linearly polarized pump preserves PT symmetry, leaving the Floquet quasienergies spin degenerate. Under near-resonant driving, photon-dressed conduction and valence bands hybridize, producing spin-dependent relative phases that are converted into unequal spin-resolved photoemission intensities through interference between pathways reaching the same Volkov-dressed final state. We analytically identify this interference mechanism and verify it using nonequilibrium Green-function calculations under periodic driving and finite pump-probe pulses. We further demonstrate that rotating the probe polarization can suppress or reverse the spin polarization without modifying the Floquet bands. Our findings establish Floquet-Volkov interference as a route to spin-selective photoemission in driven antiferromagnets without Floquet spin splitting or SOC.
core_items.abstract_zh: 周期性驱动可以通过形成光子修饰的 Floquet-Bloch 态来超快控制固体中的电子结构。然而，测量的光发射光谱不仅受到这些状态的影响，而且还受到它们对沃尔科夫装饰的出射光电子的干扰的影响。在这里，我们证明了 Floquet-Volkov 干涉可以在没有自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的共线反铁磁狄拉克模型中产生自旋偏振光电发射。面内线性极化泵浦保持 PT 对称性，使 Floquet 准能量自旋简并。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 周期性驱动可以通过形成光子修饰的 Floquet-Bloch 态来超快控制固体中的电子结构。然而，测量的光发射光谱不仅受到这些状态的影响，而且还受到它们对沃尔科夫装饰的出射光电子的干扰的影响。在这里，我们证明了 Floquet-Volkov 干涉可以在没有自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的共线反铁磁狄拉克模型中产生自旋偏振光电发射。面内线性极化泵浦保持 PT 对称性，使 Floquet 准能量自旋简并。在近共振驱动下，光子修饰的导带和价带杂交，产生自旋相关的相对相位，通过达到相同沃尔科夫修饰的最终状态的路径之间的干扰，这些相对相位转换为不相等的自旋分辨光电发射强度。我们分析地识别了这种干扰机制，并在周期性驱动和有限泵浦探测脉冲下使用非平衡格林函数计算来验证它。我们进一步证明，旋转探针偏振可以抑制或逆转自旋偏振，而不改变 Floquet 能带。我们的研究结果表明，Floquet-Volkov 干涉是在驱动反铁磁体中实现自旋选择性光电发射的一种途径，无需 Floquet 自旋分裂或 SOC。

core_items.title_en: Quantum Spin Wave Theory with Multi-Spin Interactions for Magnetic Materials Modeling
core_items.title_zh: 用于磁性材料建模的多自旋相互作用的量子自旋波理论
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.06833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the field of magnetism within condensed matter physics, magnetic systems are microscopically described by a spin Hamiltonian. Its parameterization is accessible through both ab initio calculations and fits to experimental data. Frequently, this is achieved via multi-stage calculations that either relate the parameters to observable material properties or map a Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian onto an effective spin model. In this realm, accurate and flexible methods are essential for simulating the physical properties of the latter. The present study focuses on one such method: spin wave theory. The approach is applied to a new formulation of the spin Hamiltonian, named polynomial localized spin model (PLSM), which includes terms of arbitrary order in the spin operators. This enables the direct application of linear spin wave theory (LSWT) to the analysis of the energy landscape and spin-wave spectrum of arbitrary collinear and non-collinear phases in any realistic magnetic material. Moreover, the classical and quantum parts of the PLSM are cleanly separated. Finally, an open-source implementation of LSWT, named Magnopy, is presented. It interfaces with modern parameterization software, supports arbitrary collinear and non-collinear systems, and is designed for both scripting and standalone use.
core_items.abstract_zh: 在凝聚态物理的磁性领域中，磁系统由自旋哈密顿量在微观上描述。其参数化可通过从头计算和拟合实验数据来实现。通常，这是通过多阶段计算来实现的，这些计算要么将参数与可观察的材料特性相关联，要么将 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量映射到有效的自旋模型上。在这个领域，准确而灵活的方法对于模拟后者的物理特性至关重要。本研究的重点是这样一种方法：自旋波理论。该方法应用于自旋哈密顿量的新公式，称为多项式局部自旋模型（PLSM），其中包括自旋算子中的任意阶项。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 在凝聚态物理的磁性领域中，磁系统由自旋哈密顿量在微观上描述。其参数化可通过从头计算和拟合实验数据来实现。通常，这是通过多阶段计算来实现的，这些计算要么将参数与可观察的材料特性相关联，要么将 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量映射到有效的自旋模型上。在这个领域，准确而灵活的方法对于模拟后者的物理特性至关重要。本研究的重点是这样一种方法：自旋波理论。该方法应用于自旋哈密顿量的新公式，称为多项式局部自旋模型（PLSM），其中包括自旋算子中的任意阶项。这使得线性自旋波理论 (LSWT) 能够直接应用于分析任何现实磁性材料中任意共线和非共线相的能量景观和自旋波谱。此外，PLSM 的经典部分和量子部分完全分离。最后，提出了 LSWT 的开源实现，名为 Magnopy。它与现代参数化软件接口，支持任意共线和非共线系统，并且设计用于脚本编写和独立使用。

core_items.title_en: Machine-Learning-Accelerated Metallene Stabilization from High-Throughput Sandwich Modeling
core_items.title_zh: 高通量三明治建模的机器学习加速金属稳定
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2608.01779v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Metallenes have appealing properties, but stabilizing them in a monolayer phase poses synthesis challenges. A recent experiment showed that the van der Waals squeezing method can stabilize certain metallenes in a MoS2 sandwich. This pioneering work motivates systematic studies, but such studies are experimentally impractical, while first-principles modeling remains prohibitive. Here, using universal machine-learning interatomic potentials, we constructed 1620 metallene sandwich heterostructures containing 6 different sandwich layers and 45 metals. We performed phonon calculations, which revealed 1208 dynamically stable structures and narrowed them to 331 after structural filtering. We found that Se-based transition-metal dichalcogenides stabilize metallenes effectively. Specifically, hexagonal and buckled hexagonal crystal lattices exhibit the greatest stability. We further evaluated the thermal stability of selected heterostructures with density-functional theory molecular dynamics simulations at room temperature. By uncovering the physical and chemical factors that govern metallenes stabilization, our results provide systematic insights to guide and accelerate synthesis for future applications.
core_items.abstract_zh: 金属具有吸引人的特性，但将其稳定在单层相中会带来合成挑战。最近的一项实验表明，范德华挤压法可以稳定MoS2夹层中的某些金属。这项开创性的工作激发了系统研究，但这些研究在实验上是不切实际的，而第一原理建模仍然令人望而却步。在这里，我们使用通用机器学习原子间电位，构建了1620个金属夹层异质结构，包含6个不同的夹层和45种金属。我们进行了声子计算，揭示了1208个动态稳定的结构，并在结构滤波后将其缩小到331个。我们发现硒基过渡金属二硫族化合物能有效地稳定金属。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 金属具有吸引人的特性，但将其稳定在单层相中会带来合成挑战。最近的一项实验表明，范德华挤压法可以稳定MoS2夹层中的某些金属。这项开创性的工作激发了系统研究，但这些研究在实验上是不切实际的，而第一原理建模仍然令人望而却步。在这里，我们使用通用机器学习原子间电位，构建了1620个金属夹层异质结构，包含6个不同的夹层和45种金属。我们进行了声子计算，揭示了1208个动态稳定的结构，并在结构滤波后将其缩小到331个。我们发现硒基过渡金属二硫族化合物能有效地稳定金属。具体而言，六边形和屈曲六边形晶格表现出最大的稳定性。我们进一步使用密度泛函理论分子动力学模拟在室温下评估了选定异质结构的热稳定性。通过揭示控制金属稳定性的物理和化学因素，我们的研究结果提供了系统的见解，以指导和加速未来应用的合成。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹, 第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《高通量三明治建模的机器学习加速金属稳定》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Subtle Energy Corrections Reshape Condensed-Phase Property Predictions from a Machine-Learning Interatomic Potential
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Subtle Energy Corrections Reshape Condensed-Phase Property Predictions from a Machine-Learning Interatomic Potential
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.06109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate reproduction of electronic-structure labels by machine-learning interatomic potentials does not necessarily ensure reliable condensed-phase properties. We investigate the effects of basis-set superposition error (BSSE) and an explicit Axilrod-Teller-Muto (ATM) three-body dispersion contribution on molecular-liquid predictions. Starting from MACELES-OFF, we fine-tune a baseline potential at the ωB97M-V/def2-TZVPD level. A separate branch learns counterpoise (CP) energy and force corrections with the baseline frozen, while a D4-parametrized ATM term is added during molecular-dynamics inference. Mean atom-normalized CP and ATM contributions are 0.222 and 0.205 meV/atom, respectively, for the analyzed SPICE2 configurations from OMol25. We compare baseline, CP-only, ATM-only, and CP + ATM variants for 39 organic liquids. Relative to baseline, the mean system-wise density changes are -1.17%, -10.38%, and -11.93% for CP-only, ATM-only, and CP + ATM, respectively; the corresponding enthalpy-of-vaporization changes are -2.79%, -14.74%, and -18.32%. For the 11 liquids with experimental self-diffusion data, the mean self-diffusion changes are +17.66%, +203.02%, and +230.36%. Both corrections thus lower density and enthalpy of vaporization while increasing molecular mobility on average. ATM dominates these changes, while CP provides a smaller contribution; their combination yields the largest average shifts. These results show that corrections with sub-meV/atom mean values on the analyzed configurations can substantially reshape the predicted structural, thermodynamic, and transport properties of molecular liquids.

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《量子化学的可转移神经网络量子态方法》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
